description: This file defines a PHP class 'Parser' with methods to parse system information such as PCI devices, PCI configuration, and filesystems by executing system commands and processing their output.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class providing methods to parse system hardware and filesystem information.

methods.name: parse_lspci
methods.description: Executes 'lspci' command, processes output to extract device names, and returns sorted list.

methods.name: parse_pciconf
methods.description: Executes 'pciconf -lv', processes output to extract vendor and device info, and returns sorted results.

methods.name: parse_filesystems
methods.description: Executes 'df' and 'mount' commands, processes output to gather filesystem usage and mount info.
